items.title: George Shearing interviewed by Joe Williams, New York City, New York, March 8, 1996
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Ellie and I talk all the time... [INTERVIEWEE] They would dance us to death...

ctx.x: Willie Smith and that whole bunch. But they could swing you into — I mean dance you to death. When they would start playing “River St. Marie” and they’d change keys, they’d say [scats]. Oh man.

Ellie and I talk all the time about the time that we went to Rockefeller Center for New Year’s and danced to Sy Oliver. And I said, “Can you give me a Lunceford?” First of all he played several Lunceford charts. I said, “Ellie, this is as close as you’re going to get.” But oh, that band.
They would dance us to death when they’d come to Chicago, you know? Every number. And the ballads were just as pretty.
